query: SELECT CASE WHEN c.publication_state='NEVER_PUBLISHED' AND c.resolution_code='EXPLAINED' THEN 'PUBLISHED_EXPLAINED' WHEN c.publication_state='NEVER_PUBLISHED' THEN 'PUBLISHED_ANOMALY' ELSE c.publication_state::text END publication_state, GREATEST(COALESCE(c.current_publication_revision,0), COALESCE((SELECT max(r.revision) FROM editorial.publication_revisions r WHERE r.case_id=c.id),0))+1 revision, NULLIF(GREATEST(COALESCE(c.current_publication_revision,0), COALESCE((SELECT max(r.revision) FROM editorial.publication_revisions r WHERE r.case_id=c.id),0)),0) current_publication_revision FROM editorial.cases c WHERE c.id=$1 FOR UPDATE OF c
